description: This file defines a React component for a Todo application, including component logic, state management, routing, and rendering.

classes.name: TodoApp
classes.description: Main React component managing the Todo list, including filtering, editing, and rendering.

methods.name: componentDidMount
methods.description: Initializes routing and sets up URL-based view filtering.

methods.name: handleNewTodoKeyDown
methods.description: Handles key down events for creating new todos.

methods.name: toggleAll
methods.description: Toggles all todos as completed or active.

methods.name: toggle
methods.description: Toggles the completion state of a specific todo.

methods.name: edit
methods.description: Sets a todo into editing mode.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves changes to a todo after editing.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the Todo component with filtered todos and controls.
